text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... That was a great sleep! I'm gonna 
give it my all today, too—!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oops? Looks like I woke up a 
little bit too early.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... What should I do? There's still 
some time before training starts...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! That's it! Since I have the chance, 
I'm gonna tune up my mountain bike!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Now that that's settled! 
Let's get ready with everything we've got 
and start right away!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Whew! Yep, that takes care of this 
part!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Maintenance really is fun after all~! I'm 
so excited, I can't wait to ride it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to tinker with it much 
lately, so I want to swap out a buuuunch 
of parts, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOAAAHHH!! I'm fired up now!! I'm gonna 
keep giving it way, waaay more 
effortーーー!!

...After that, Winning Ticket kept 
cleaning her mountain bike with all her 
might, completely ditching her training 
session.
